data.name: Heemaan
data.gender_notes: Heemaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-n', meaning 'to be wise, intelligent, or bright'. In Islamic tradition, the name Heemaan is believed to represent the qualities of wisdom, intelligence, and strength. The name Heemaan carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Heemaan usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, and the development of a deep understanding of the world and oneself.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heemaan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
